messages:
sara_kaplan: Evening shift handover — quick async. Observed elevated embed latency (p95 ~ +180ms) for eu-west1 since ~19:10 UTC and a kvcache eviction spike. Mitigations: scaled kv-cache replica set +2, temporarily reduced per-client burst to 8 rps, and enabled fallback to smaller-quant model (redwood-embed-compact) for non-critical flows. Created incident INC-8721. I'll monitor dashboards/logs and leave follow-ups below.

matt_vasquez: Thanks. Do we have links to the incident and the graphs? Also — do we want to roll back the recent embed-inference deploy if memory pressure persists? I can roll it back quickly.

sara_kaplan: Dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/d/embeds/eu-west1?view=kv-evictions — pasted into the incident. At the moment I'm not seeing a clear deploy correlation (last deploy at 18:40 UTC according to deploy-bot), so holding rollback as an option.

jordan_ng: FYI logs show a burst of fs-sync IO at ~19:09 UTC — looks like a background snapshot job overlapped with a traffic spike. I recommend pausing snapshot job for 1 hour and rescheduling to off-peak. I also kicked off a purge for stale cache keys on the eu-west1 node group. Command I ran:```kubectl exec -it cache-maintainer -- /bin/sh -c "python purge_stale_keys.py --region eu-west1 --age 3600"```

lee: I'm taking the next shift (start 22:00 UTC). I'll watch SLOs and confirm snapshot pause. @sara_kaplan can you add the snapshot job suspend step to INC-8721 so it's tracked?

opsbot: ALERT: embed_kv_evictions (eu-west1) crossed threshold at 19:12 UTC — current rate 420/min (threshold 200). Incident INC-8721 created and routed to oncall.

matt_vasquez: Added PR to infra autoscaler: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/542 — lowers scale-down aggression and increases max replicas for kvcache. Pinged infra for a quick review.

sara_kaplan: Good plan. Next steps: 1) confirm snapshot job suspended (jordan). 2) monitor evictions for 30m. 3) if evictions don't drop >=20% within 30m, consider rolling back embed-inference deploy and open a capacity increase request for the Dedicated pool. I'm offline at <23:00 UTC; @lee will take over monitoring. :thumbsup:

lee: Got it, will take over and escalate if anything spikes. :wave:
